+from datetime import date
+
+from datekit import add_business_days
+
+
+def test_monday_minus_one_is_previous_friday():
+    assert add_business_days(date(2026, 1, 5), -1) == date(2026, 1, 2)
+
+
+def test_friday_minus_four_is_monday():
+    assert add_business_days(date(2026, 1, 9), -4) == date(2026, 1, 5)
+
+
+def test_backward_from_weekend():
+    # Sunday Jan 11 minus one business day is Friday Jan 9.
+    assert add_business_days(date(2026, 1, 11), -1) == date(2026, 1, 9)
+
+
+def test_zero_returns_start():
+    assert add_business_days(date(2026, 1, 10), 0) == date(2026, 1, 10)
